title: New faces for old foes
text:
Nine monsters get brand-new 3D models, and Vyrathos is tamed down to size.

✨ Vyrathos, the Ember Tyrant is now a black dragon with its own breathing, wing and tail animation. It snaps with its whole neck and rolls onto its side when it falls
🔧 Vyrathos is now a sensible size and no longer wanders around its platform: it waits, breathing, until someone attacks, so it stops clipping through the arena
✨ Tidecallers at Mirrowmere are now the Hollow Magus: a hooded skeletal sorcerer with a glowing skull, floating above the shore
✨ Bog Witches in Gloamfen are now the Moonbound Oracle: a horned sorceress with a crescent-moon staff
✨ Cinderback Crushers in the Scorched Reach are now hunched, spined beasts with long bladed tails that lunge at you
✨ Glimmerwing Moths are now giant moths with beating wings and faintly glowing wing patterns
✨ Old Tusk is now a scarred, clawed beast with a long tail that pounces at you
✨ Drowned Sailors are now chained, rotting horrors that stagger toward you
✨ Murkshell Crabs are now hunched lake ghouls with their own animations for prowling, biting, clawing, flinching and dying
✨ Grimmaw of the Deep is now a towering six-legged bone-crawler that skitters on its legs and snaps its jaws
